## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-bf11b7b4)

## Summary

Completes the wall/opening edit-parity port deferred from REV35-GEOMPORT (#494). All four implementable items now run on the `RoomGeometryInputController` + `RoomGeometryPanel` path; the fifth (always-on wall-prism overlay in normal view) is intentionally skipped because it changes default-view visuals and is a product/UX call, not a mechanical port.

- **E3 wrap-around merge**: `merge_walls` now accepts the last→first wall pair across the polygon's boundary seam (`walls[1:-1] + [merged]` keeps boundary order; existing opening/binding migration is reused unchanged). The merge button relabels to 「先頭の壁と結合」 on the last wall, replacing the old "末尾と先頭の壁結合は現在のUIでは未対応です" refusal. A ≥3-wall guard (`'a room must keep at least three walls'`) blocks merging a triangle down to two walls.
- **E4 arbitrary-offset split**: new `insert_selected_edge_vertex(offset_m)` — `None` keeps midpoint behavior; an explicit offset validates `0 < offset < edge_length` (「分割位置は辺の内側を指定してください」) and routes through `split_wall(..., offset_m=...)` so openings and bindings migrate. The panel adds a 「分割位置」 spin (reset to the edge midpoint on each edge selection) plus a 「指定位置に頂点追加」 button; 「中点に頂点追加」 is unchanged.
- **E2+E5 binding edit/delete authority**: two domain verbs on the same pattern as `add_constraint_binding` — `update_constraint_binding(room, topology, binding)` and `delete_constraint_binding(room, topology, binding_id)` — that rebuild the `WallTopology` and revalidate. The clearance section now mirrors the opening editor: a 参照の選択 combo (「新規 / 未選択」 plus per-binding `0.30 m` labels, `（N壁）` for multi-wall bindings) and 追加/適用/削除 buttons. Editing which walls a binding covers stays out of scope.
- **E1 skipped (product decision)**: the always-on wall-prism/opening overlay in the normal (non-edit) view changes default 3D presentation; visibility rules and render cost are UX decisions. `docs/reviews/rev35-geomport.md` records the final parity state per item, including this rationale.

Tests: 14 new cases in `backend/tests/test_rev36_geomport2.py` covering domain and panel/controller paths, including wrap-merge opening/binding migration and the non-collinear refusal. Scoped run — test_rev36_geomport2, test_cad_walls, test_cad_wall_bindings, test_cad_wall_scene, test_rev35_geomport, test_room_cadux, test_room_workspace: 87 passed.

Real-GUI verification (Windows, Mesa llvmpipe): wrap merge of the last→first wall succeeded end to end (「隣接する壁を結合しました」, 5→4 vertices, merged wall 31.98 m); offset split inserted a vertex at 3.0 m on the selected edge (「壁参照を維持して頂点を追加しました」); the binding 追加→選択→0.50 m 適用→削除 cycle was exercised live; a non-collinear merge is still correctly refused by the domain layer.
